capabilities: Generate cited Vault Radar briefs from recently changed notes
Chat with vault, folder, tag, or selection-scoped notes with clickable citations
Show semantically related notes while writing via a local embedding index
Run summarize, rewrite, and task-extraction text actions from the command palette
Draft weekly reviews, meeting tasks, and project updates as approval-gated changes
extras: No telemetry or hosted backend; only Ollama is described as end-to-end smoke-tested, other OpenAI-compatible servers rely on a shared request contract. Automatic Radar runs and indexing are off by default. Radar never edits notes, and Canvas creation requires explicit confirmation.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to use a local LLM to surface signals from changed notes, chat with vault context, or keep semantically related notes visible while writing.
